confusions: Navigation through the ashwood to reach watchtower and shrine took several turns to figure out the correct path, though exploration-based discovery is likely intentional
suggestions: Scholar class makes verse collection trivial with no puzzles; consider this may undermine challenge on easier paths
Initial notice board or NPC dialogue could hint at verse locations more explicitly for first-time players
The barrow warning ('come empty-handed and the king takes you') was well-communicated and created good tension
